cohort: A young pregnant woman diagnosed with congenital uterovaginal prolapse and infravaginal elongation of the cervix who presented in labor.
finding: This case report describes a rare instance of infravaginal elongation of the cervix in a young pregnant woman, which led to complications during labor.
mod_finding: Infravaginal elongation of the cervix necessitated an emergency lower segment cesarean section due to failure of cervical dilatation and breech presentation.
